jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success & Account Manager (AEO)
jobs.description:
**About Conductor:**

Conductor is the leading enterprise AEO platform. Today’s top enterprise brands use Conductor to grow authority and visibility in both AI and traditional search engines. From tracking visibility in LLMs to real-time monitoring of technical site health and scaled AI content creation, Conductor provides a single source of truth that fuels digital growth—all from one platform.

Conductor is a mission-driven company with a commitment to innovation, customer success, and culture. For Conductor, success is improving the lives of everyone in our orbit—our customers, our customers' customers, our employee-owners, and our communities.

**We are open to NYC, SF or Denver based candidates.**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a high-impact **AEO Program Manager** to act as the primary strategic and operational advisor for our enterprise customers. Combining executive account management and deep strategic platform enablement, this hybrid role bridges commercial vision with hands-on value delivery. You will own the holistic customer partnership—aligning organic marketing goals with Conductor’s AEO solutions, driving platform adoption, uncovering expansion opportunities, and ensuring exceptional executive outcomes.

**What You'll Do (Responsibilities)**
-------------------------------------

* **Account Ownership & Strategic Alignment:** Act as the primary business and technical owner of assigned enterprise accounts. Define and implement clear account business plans that align customer strategic objectives with Conductor's platform capabilities.
* **Executive Relationship Building:** Cultivate trusted, long-term relationships with C-level executives, marketing leaders, and key sponsors. Conduct structured business reviews (QBRs/EBRs)
* **Expansion & Opportunity Identification:** Leverage deep understanding of customer business strategy to identify new business opportunities, expansion paths, and platform upgrades in partnership with Sales and Pre-Sales.
* **Platform Enablement & Adoption:** Serve as the primary subject matter expert on Conductor’s AEO features, leading strategic onboarding, user enablement, standard methodology training, and driving platform adoption across enterprise teams.
* **Cross-Functional Advocacy:** Champion client needs internally, collaborating seamlessly with Dedicated Renewal Specialists, Professional Services, Solutions Consulting, and Product teams to resolve complex challenges and maintain exceptional customer satisfaction.
* **Data Storytelling & Reporting:** Construct compelling reports and customized dashboards to find the “story” in data, directly tying AEO and technical SEO performance to tangible business impact and ROI.
* **Risk Mitigation & Health Management:** Proactively monitor account health metrics, platform utilization trends, and operational risks to ensure long-term account vitality and value realization.

**Who You Are (Required Skills/Abilities)**
-------------------------------------------

* **Experience:** **6 to 8+ years o**f experience in Enterprise Account Management, Customer Success, or Strategic Consulting within a B2B SaaS environment.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Deep proficiency in Digital Marketing, with hands-on expertise or strong familiarity in SEO, AEO, content strategy, and web/IT infrastructure.
* **Executive Presence:** Proven track record of consulting directly with C-suite executives and IT/procurement stakeholders, conveying complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively.
* **Tech & Systems Fluency:** Strong proficiency in Salesforce and enterprise analytics platforms. Comfortable navigating web-based technical conversations.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Adept at account planning, discovery, value-mapping, and identifying account expansion opportunities (while leaving renewal mechanics to specialists).
* **Education & Travel:** BA/BS degree or equivalent experience. Willingness to travel (10%+) for on-site client business reviews and adoption workshops.

The future of work is transformed at Conductor, and we don’t just use AI - we weave it into everything we do. We prioritize hiring individuals who stay ahead of the curve, seeking "AI leading" talent who are curious, adaptable, and skilled at utilizing AI to amplify their specific roles. Because we are committed to this tech-forward environment, every candidate’s journey includes a dedicated assessment of their AI literacy and competency by a specialized panel of experts to ensure you are ready to thrive and lead at Conductor.

**Compensation**: Conductor maintains competitive, performance-based compensation programs.

The **base salary range** for this role is **currently $90,000-105,000/year. Variable compensation:** In addition to the base salary, this role is also eligible for a variable bonus based on attainment of quota and performance targets. **This operates a 70/30 split.** With full achievement of your quota, your **On-Target Earnings (OTE)** can range from **$120,000-150,000 annually.**

Actual base salary offered may vary within this range based on education, knowledge, skills, abilities, relevant experience, internal equity, and geographic location, among other factors. The actual compensation, if offered a position, will be based on these factors.

Conductor LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Bringing in diverse perspectives and challenging our assumptions is the clear key to growth; it drives innovation, creativity, faster problem-solving, and stronger decision making. All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, train, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs*.*

You'll be the trusted advisor to sophisticated operators. You'll build relationships at every level, from owners and VPs to day-to-day teams. jobs.title: Manager, Technical Account Management
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is looking for a Manager, Technical Account Management to build and lead the team of Technical Account Managers who own the technical relationship with our customers. Your team is accountable for how each customer deploys, adopts, and gets value from Cyberhaven's Agentic Data Security platform, from onboarding through renewal. You will hire and develop the team, define how TAMs work with accounts, and make sure customers get a consistent, proactive technical partner and experience.

You are a people leader with a technical background in security SaaS and endpoint agents, and you are comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where the team's processes are still being written. You will coach TAMs on and step in on critical escalations when needed. You will also work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support Engineering, Customer Experience, and Sales to turn what the team learns from customers into improvements to the product and to how we serve customers.

Technical depth, a strong client focus, and experience leading customer-facing technical teams are required. You will report to the VP of Support and Technical Account Management.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead and grow the team**

* Hire, onboard, and develop Technical Account Managers. Set clear expectations, give regular feedback, and run career development and performance reviews.
* Coach TAMs on account strategy, technical troubleshooting, executive communication, and managing difficult customer situations.
* Build a team culture of growth mindset, ownership, curiosity, and accountability for customer outcomes.
* Plan headcount and coverage as the customer base grows, including how accounts are assigned and balanced across the team.

### **Define how the TAM function operates**

* Establish the TAM operating model: account segmentation, coverage, engagement cadence, business review format, and technical success plans.
* Set the team's goals and metrics, such as account health, agent coverage and deployment progress, adoption, escalation volume and time to resolution, and customer satisfaction. Report on them to leadership.
* Create and maintain playbooks, runbooks, and knowledge base standards so TAMs handle common situations the same way.
* Define the handoffs between TAMs and Customer Experience and Sales so customers always know who owns what.

### **Own customer outcomes**

* Review account health across the team's book of business and step in early on accounts at risk of low adoption, deployment problems, or churn.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical customer issues. Make sure TAMs bring clear reproductions and context to Engineering, and that customers stay informed through resolution.
* Build relationships with customes, and join executive and business reviews for strategic accounts.
* Work with Customer Success and Sales on renewals, expansions, and risk mitigation, providing technical input and account insight.

### **Be the voice of the customer**

* Collect customer feedback, feature requests, and recurring issues from the team and bring them to Product Management and Engineering with the technical and business context behind them.
* Work with Engineering and Support Engineering to improve diagnostics, debugging tools, and escalation processes.
* Run root cause analysis reviews on significant incidents and drive preventive follow-ups so issues do not repeat.
* Stay current on industry trends, security best practices, and adjacent technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, and UEBA, and bring them into the team's guidance to customers.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 3+ years of experience managing a team of Technical Account Managers, Support Engineers, Solutions Engineers, or similar customer-facing technical staff.
* 7+ years in customer-facing technical roles.
* Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong technical people, and of handling performance issues directly and fairly.
* Experience building or scaling a TAM, Support, or Customer Success function, including processes, playbooks, and metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to own customer technical outcomes from implementation through steady-state operation, and to understand a customer's architecture and environment end-to-end.
* Hands-on experience deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting SaaS-based security and/or endpoint agent technologies.
* Proven experience managing escalated technical customer issues and working directly with engineering teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English), including the ability to engage both hands-on practitioners and executive stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, set timelines, and track progress across a team and its accounts.
* Practical knowledge of networking, security products, enterprise network infrastructure, and Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoint management (SCCM, GPO, Intune, MDM, and application management).
* Ability to read and interpret logs and diagnostic output across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Google Kubernetes Engine well enough to coach others and guide technical investigations.

### **Desired**

* Familiarity with adjacent technologies that Cyberhaven integrates with (SIEM, SOAR, UEBA).
* Expertise with DLP, Insider Threat, and CASB solutions.
* Prior experience leading a TAM team at a security or SaaS company.
* Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth company where the team's processes were still being defined.
* Background in L2/L3 or Escalation Engineering for EDR or DLP tools.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.

jobs.description:
POSITION DESCRIPTION

**Position Title:** Physical Wellness Program Coordinator

**Status:** Full time, non-exempt

**Location:** Remote, preference for Texas residency

**Reports To:** Director of Physical Wellness and Sports and Recreation

**ATTENTION: Only applicants who submit a cover letter detailing why they are interested in Hope For The Warriors as well as explaining their connection to the military community will be considered . All applications MUST include: a resume, cover letter AND a complete list of any current nutrition, fitness, strength & conditioning, wellness certifications**. **Adaptive Sport Experience preferred. Please note responses must be original and written by the applicant. AI-generated submissions will not be reviewed.**

**This is an early career opportunity. Candidates with advanced degrees will also not be considered.**

**Background:**

Established in 2006, Hope For The Warriors® (Hope) is a civilian, 501(c)(3) non-profit organization. The mission of Hope For the Warriors® is to restore the quality of life for post-9/11 service members, their families, and families of the fallen who have sustained physical and psychological wounds in the line of duty. Hope For The Warriors® is dedicated to restoring a sense of self, restoring the family unit, and restoring hope for our service members and our military families.

**Core Values:**  
Hope For The Warriors® understands the challenges, pride, and joy of being a military family. For today, tomorrow, and years to come, we will strive to meet the changing needs of service members and their families. Additionally, we value community. Through our grassroots philosophy of interacting with the communities Veterans live and work in, we establish and nurture the relationships that have become the foundation of our support.

**Position Summary:**  
The Physical Wellness Program Coordinator engages members of the Warrior Community—veterans, transitioning service members, and their families—in activities that promote physical health and emotional well-being. The coordinator delivers direct support, facilitates goal setting, and manages participation in HOPE’s Physical Wellness Programs: Individual Athlete, Adaptive Equipment, and Team HOPE. This role supports clients through one-on-one communication, intake and goal assessments, motivational coaching, and event coordination. It also strengthens connections between physical activity and mental health, guiding clients toward improved quality of life. This is conducted within the scope of a holistic person-centered approach to well-being which is anchored within the delta of mind, body, and spirit.

**Primary Role:**

The Physical Wellness Program Coordinator provides communication, evaluation and resources to all clients who are seeking opportunities to better their physical health and wellness. The Program Coordinator conducts engagement calls and written communication to incoming HOPE clientele (athletes) to create, foster and establish a trusting, confident and reliable relationship. The Program Coordinator will conduct initial interest surveys and goal setting sessions with the purpose of understanding the physical well-being needs of the client.

The Program Coordinator provides social support, and event management services within Physical Wellness programming. These programs include Individual Athlete, Adaptive Equipment, and Team HOPE. As a regional MAY 2026 staff member, the coordinator will attend and facilitate programmatic events where they will welcome athletes and provide team-building experience.

Program Coordinator duties include assessing the needs of post 9/11 service members, veterans and their families within a client-centered approach, the connection between physical movement and mental wellbeing as well as the general physical fitness guidelines for healthy adults. The coordinator provides supportive communication, to include providing resources that support goals of clients, providing internal platforms for clients to connect to others socially, and provide aid when client may need assistance from other areas of the organization.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Conduct initial outreach and personalized goal-setting sessions focused on physical fitness, rehabilitation, and holistic well-being.
* Assess each client’s physical health status, fitness level, motivation, and potential barriers, using evidence-based wellness frameworks.
* Develop and implement individualized wellness action plans incorporating principles of adaptive fitness, injury prevention, and strength-building.
* Provide consistent coaching that integrates physical training concepts, behavioral motivation, and the connection between physical movement and mental health.
* Facilitate access to HOPE’s Physical Wellness programs, including Team HOPE, Individual Athlete, and Adaptive Equipment opportunities.
* Educate clients on physical activity guidelines for healthy adults, including progressive overload, flexibility, cardiovascular endurance, and nutrition basics.
* Track and document all client interactions, milestones, and outcomes in Salesforce to support data-informed program delivery.
* Coordinate participant recruitment, preparation, and logistics for Team HOPE events; provide on-site support and team-building experiences.
* Travel to and represent HOPE at national physical wellness events (supporting at least 50% of events in person).
* Collaborate with interdisciplinary HOPE staff to ensure clients are connected to financial, emotional, and social support services.
* Maintain strict compliance with HIPAA and data privacy standards; ensure thorough documentation of client progress and service delivery.
* Contribute to ongoing program development, quality assurance, and evaluation efforts to refine the impact of physical wellness services.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in kinesiology, recreational therapy, behavioral health, or related field.
* 1-3 years’ ex

Position Summary:

NV5 is a provider of engineering and consulting services to public and private sector clients, delivering solutions through six business verticals: Testing, Inspection & Consulting; Infrastructure; Utility Services; Environmental Health Sciences; Buildings & Program Management; and Geospatial Technology. With offices nationwide and abroad, NV5 helps clients plan, design, build, test, certify, and operate projects that improve the communities where we live and work.

As engineers, architects, construction/program managers, environmental professionals and beyond, we play a significant role in shaping our communities through the services we provide. We are looking for passionate, driven individuals to join our team focused on *Delivering Solutions and Improving Lives*.

Serving as the primary client interface, the Senior Project Manager implements schedule and scope controls, manages complex supply chains for geographically diverse sites, and leads the development of engineering deliverables. Our goal is to help Americans find convenient and affordable healthcare. We offer solutions for consumers, employers, health plans, and anyone else who shares our desire to provide affordable prescriptions to all Americans.

**Customer Success Manager**

**About the organization**

Founded as a nonprofit organization in 2020, the National Summer School Initiative (NSSI) partners with schools and districts nationwide to accelerate learning and deepen teacher practice through our distinctive summer programming.

NSSI programming offers districts a new approach to building teacher capacity and driving academic gains. Our mentor teacher model connects some of the country's most exceptional educators with teachers across the nation, equipping and inspiring them to deliver discourse-rich math and literature lessons that are rigorous, culturally responsive, and deeply engaging.

Through intensive pre-service training and dynamic weekly professional development sessions, our summer programming focuses on research-proven instructional practices that accelerate learning. We provide teachers and school leaders with the targeted support and hands-on practice needed to elevate their craft. Our core belief is simple: teachers get better faster by observing the best and practicing.

Our comprehensive approach combines daily exposure to excellent curriculum, observation of outstanding mentor teachers, targeted professional development to help teachers across the country improve rapidly and effectively, and exceptional operational support.

Impact and Growth: In 2026, NSSI served approximately 82,000 students. Building from 48,000 students served in 2023, we continue to refine our approach to maximize impact. With a goal of reaching 130,000 students by summer 2029, we are positioned for strategic growth based on our strong track record of results. Students consistently achieve double-digit learning gains on average across all partner sites, while stakeholder satisfaction remains remarkably high.

**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

At Humana, we are focused on maximizing the value of our investments and ensuring disciplined financial management across our portfolio of initiatives. In this role, you will lead financial operations, budget planning, forecasting, value management, and investment evaluation activities that support executive decision-making and strategic portfolio governance. You will partner across business, technology, finance, and operational teams to identify opportunities, quantify value, evaluate investment decisions, and monitor realization of expected outcomes.

The core work hours will be based on EASTERN time, with flexibility based on exact location.

The Delivery Lead oversees financial operations and value management activities that enable effective portfolio governance and investment decision-making. This role is responsible for operational budget management, forecasting, invoicing oversight, financial reporting, and performance tracking across a complex portfolio of initiatives.

The Delivery Lead develops business cases, identifies and quantifies expected value, supports investment evaluations, and establishes processes to monitor benefits realization. This role partners with leaders across the organization to evaluate new opportunities, assess strategic investments, and ensure alignment between financial commitments and expected business outcomes.

The selected candidate will establish portfolio-level reporting and scorecards, monitor expected versus realized value, identify risks and opportunities impacting financial performance, and provide recommendations to senior leadership to support strategic decision-making.

The Delivery Lead exercises independent judgment and decision-making on complex issues, works under minimal supervision, and requires strong analytical, financial, and stakeholder management capabilities.

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead operational budget management, forecasting, invoicing, and financial planning activities.
* Develop and maintain portfolio-level financial reporting and performance scorecards.
* Partner with business and technology leaders to develop business cases and investment recommendations.
* Identify, quantify, and track expected value associated with strategic initiatives.
* Establish and maintain processes for value realization measurement and reporting.
* Support portfolio governance processes, including investment prioritization and funding reviews.
* Analyze financial and operational performance trends and make recommendations to improve outcomes.
* Communicate portfolio performance, investment recommendations, and realized value to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
* Maintain visibility into portfolio spend, forecast accuracy, and investment performance.
* Drive continuous improvement of value management and financial operations capabilities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or 7+ years of healthcare, finance, operations, strategy, or portfolio management experience.
* 5+ years of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, or business operations experience.
* Experience developing business cases and evaluating investment opportunities.
* Experience analyzing and communicating financial and operational performance metrics.
* Experience leading highly complex cross-functional initiatives.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and executive communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and financial modeling.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting large-scale healthcare, technology, or transformation portfolios.
* Experience with benefits realization, value management, or portfolio management disciplines.
* Experience preparing materials and recommendations for executive leadership review.
* Knowledge of healthcare payer operations, Stars, Risk Adjustment, Clinical Data Exchange, or Technology portfolios.
* MBA, CPA, PMP, or similar advanced certification.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Operations and Automation Manager  
Link 360 | Remote (US) | Full time  
$60,000-$70,000 base, $85,000-$95,000 target total comp

We run outbound revenue programs for our clients. A client signs, and thirty days later they have a working team including the technology that helps it run: a CRM built out, email and LinkedIn campaigns live, a dedicated Sales Development Rep on the phones, and meetings landing on their calendar.

Right now about sixty separate tasks stand between the signature and the launch, and all of them are manual. We're hiring the person who takes that over and then makes most of it run without a person touching it. – Not to replace you, to streamline what you have to do so you can focus on critical human operational activities.

That second part is the actual job. If you've built AI agents and automations that do real work unattended, you'd be designing the automation layer for this entire company from scratch. No legacy system to work around, no committee, direct line to the founder. Build it well and the job gets smaller every quarter, you.. get more focused on the most valuable activities we can’t or don’t want to automate with Ai. Which is exactly what we're paying for.

**What you'd do**

Build the client systems. GoHighLevel sub-accounts, pipelines, calendars, forms, workflows. Sending domains and DNS, mailbox warmup, A2P registration, dialer setup, CRM integrations. If a workflow breaks at 7am you're the one who knows why.

Automate the onboarding. Take the sixty-task launch checklist and cut it down. Agents, automations, templates, whatever works. We'll set a baseline in your first week and part of your bonus is paid on how far you move it.

Produce the campaigns. Each client segment needs an email sequence, a LinkedIn sequence, an SDR call guide, a one-page document, and a landing page. You'll use AI to produce them and edit until they don't read like AI wrote them.

Approve the data. Our data team builds the lists. You check them, filter them, scrub them, and decide what gets imported. A bad list wastes a month of calling.

Run SDR coaching. Weekly call recording reviews, written feedback, role plays, and updates to the call guide based on what you hear. You run the routine and improve it.

Document everything. You're the first person in this seat. What you build becomes the training system for everyone after you.

**What we need you to already have**

You've built AI agents or multi-step automations that run on their own and do real operational work. Content, enrichment, reporting, QA, handoffs between systems. This one isn't negotiable and we'll ask you to walk us through what you built.

Two to four years in marketing ops, revenue ops, sales ops, or agency account management, with your hands in the tools rather than overseeing someone else's.

You've built inside a CRM and marketing automation platform. GoHighLevel is a big plus. Serious build work in HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Keap, or Salesforce counts if you pick up platforms fast.

You understand cold email infrastructure. SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warmup, deliverability troubleshooting.

You write well. Some of what you produce goes out under a client's name.

You're organized past the point other people find reasonable. Checklists, documentation, follow-through. Our launch dates are contractual and about sixty things have to happen in thirty days to hit one.

**What we offer**

$60,000 to $70,000 base depending on experience and location, with the top of the range for someone who already has both the AI build background and the operations background. Performance pay on top, paid on task completion and on-time launches, automation you build that measurably cuts manual work, on-time client deliverables, and client retention. Target total is $85,000 to $95,000 in year one and grows past six figures as the client portfolio grows.

Fully remote. We're based in Phoenix and work nationally. Some overlap with Mountain Time required.

Real ownership, which at our size means something. You'll be building the system this company runs on instead of maintaining someone else's.

**How to apply**

Send a resume and a short note covering two things: an automation or agent you built that's still running, and the messiest process you've ever cleaned up. We read these. A generic cover letter tells us nothing.

Pay: $85,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience building Ai automation and/or Ai Employees?
* Do you have experience improving operations and service delivery for a company inside a business services industry?

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager
jobs.description:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high-risk product decisions, often in fast-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively identifying important problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to the strategy and roadmap for cross-functional risk review. This role requires sound judgment, strategic thinking, and experience operating across multiple risk domains.This is a senior individual-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering large-scale programs, aligning solutions across multiple teams, and gaining recognition as a subject-matter expert whose advice is sought out across the product and risk community.  
  
  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the triage and escalation process for product risks that are novel, ambiguous, or policy-challenging
* Coordinate across Legal, Policy, Data Strategy, Engineering, and Product to ensure high-risk reviews are surfaced and addressed with the appropriate depth and speed
* network with and appropriately involve key stakeholders, persuading diverse audiences to drive progress
* Translate complex technical and product concepts into structured assessments and recommendations
* Facilitate decision-making through risk-based frameworks that support both product velocity and compliance
* seek clarity on goals and priorities so work can move forward quickly, and escalate as needed
* Ensure escalations are documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency, maintaining appropriate documentation and timely follow-through
* Identify gaps or breakdowns in current escalation/review processes and drive improvements in workflows, guidance, or tooling
* actively experiment and seek opportunities to simplify work through AI-integrated workflows
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations and make decisions that reflect our mission, values, and principles, informed by risk reviews and compliance guidance

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust & safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver time-sensitive, high-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists
* Strong communication and cross-functional alignment skills — especially in navigating sensitive tradeoffs
* Familiarity with data flows, technical systems, and/or understanding of product risks and their applicable mitigations
* Track record of influencing decisions and driving progress without formal authority
* Experience building, improving, or operationalizing risk review, escalation, assessment, or governance processes
* Strong judgment in situations involving competing priorities, incomplete information, and significant business, regulatory, safety, privacy, or reputational risk
* Experience using AI/automation to improve complex workflows, analysis, decision-making, or operational processes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort embracing ambiguity and improving systems

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing and driving strategy or roadmap for cross-functional projects and/or teams
Experience with product launches, 0* 1 products, emerging technologies, or novel product capabilities
* Background in triaging or adjudicating product-level risks, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience working with AI agents, automation, or other emerging technologies to improve risk assessment and operational efficiency
* Comfort presenting risk perspectives to senior stakeholders and leading through ambiguity
* Understanding of regulatory, reputational, or policy risks related to consumer-facing technology
* Experience with consumer-facing technology, platforms, AI/ML products, infrastructure, or other technically complex products
* Experience working on privacy, content, legal, or compliance-related product issues
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate

jobs.title: PMP Certified Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About MTW Solutions**:
  
MTW Solutions (MTW) is a dynamic software company dedicated to driving digital transformation in government operations. We specialize in mission-critical software platforms and services designed to enhance efficiency, security, and scalability for government agencies. Our flagship products include:

* **GMS**: Grant Management Software for state agencies.
* **COMPAS**: Compliance Audit System Application for state agencies.
* **Harvest**: Child Nutrition Management Software for K12 state agencies.

**Position Overview**:
  
The PMP Certified Project Manager at MTW Solutions leads complex software implementation, enhancement, reporting, and operational projects for government agency clients. This role is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering projects within agreed scope, timeline, budget, quality, and stakeholder expectations. The Project Manager applies PMP-based project management discipline to align business objectives, client requirements, internal resources, risks, and delivery outcomes across MTW’s product portfolio, including COMPAS, GMS, and Harvest™.

**Key Responsibilities**:

* **Project Planning and Governance**: Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, schedules, milestones, dependencies, assumptions, risks, and success criteria in alignment with client and business priorities.
* **Project Execution**: Lead software implementations, upgrades, reports, customizations, and operational initiatives from initiation through closure, ensuring work is completed on time, within scope, and to quality expectations.
* **Stakeholder Management**: Serve as the primary project point of contact for clients, leadership, and internal teams, maintaining clear communication, decision logs, status updates, and issue visibility.
* **Requirements and Scope Control**: Gather, clarify, document, and manage project requirements, change requests, scope impacts, and acceptance criteria throughout the project lifecycle.
* **Risk, Issue, and Dependency Management**: Identify risks, blockers, resource constraints, and cross-team dependencies early; develop mitigation plans and escalate issues through appropriate channels.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination**: Coordinate with development, technical support, finance, client account management, and leadership to align resources, priorities, deliverables, and client commitments.
* **Reporting and Controls**: Prepare project status reports, dashboards, meeting agendas, action item logs, budget or billing inputs, and executive updates to support informed decision-making.
* **Client Readiness and Transition**: Support implementation readiness, training coordination, deployment planning, acceptance activities, and transition to support or account management after project completion.

**Qualifications**:

* Bachelor’s degree in business, information technology, public administration, project management, or a related field.
* Active PMP certification required.
* 5-8 years of experience managing software, technology, implementation, or public sector projects.
* Demonstrated ability to manage project scope, schedules, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams in predictive, hybrid, or agile delivery environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive updates, project documentation, facilitation, and client-facing presentations.
* Proficiency with project management tools, Microsoft Office Suite, dashboards, action item tracking, and status reporting.
* Ability to translate business needs and technical requirements into clear project plans, specifications, acceptance criteria, and handoff materials.
* Experience with software development lifecycle processes, implementation planning, deployment coordination, and production readiness.
* Government operations, grants, compliance, or child nutrition program experience preferred.
* SQL query knowledge or experience validating client data preferred.

**What You’ll** **Lead and Gain**

* Lead software and operational projects that support digital transformation for government agencies.
* Apply PMP-based project management practices in a small business environment with direct visibility to leadership and clients.
* Gain deeper experience across the software development lifecycle, implementation planning, client delivery, and public sector operations.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

* **Salary Range:** $100,000 – $110,000 / year (commensurate with experience)
* **Benefits Package:** Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and professional development support for maintaining certifications.

### **Is This Role for You?**

If you thrive on leading complex, multi-project portfolios, excel at bridging the gap between client vision and technical software requirements, and want to make a tangible impact on government technology—we’d love to hear from you!

**Ready to shape the future of digital government solutions? Click below to Apply Now!**

jobs.description:
**About Blue Water Thinking**

Guided by our principles of value generation, continuous innovation, customer-centricity, and vested collaboration, Blue Water Thinking proudly supports our Federal clients in achieving their Agency goals.

Founded by a decorated twenty-eight year Veteran of the United States Army, Blue Water Thinking understands and supports the mission of our Nation's war fighters, Veterans, their families and caretakers.

Leveraging our executive team's military experience and private and public sector consulting expertise, Blue Water Thinking takes an integrated "one-team" approach and brings to bear best-fit solutions, thought leadership, and grit to meet our client's transformational needs.

Fueled by our values of integrity, respect, professionalism, stewardship and customer service, the Blue Water Thinking team understands the power of the human connection, collaboration, humility and loyalty to one another, our clients and industry partners.

Lastly, our formula for success is simple: Build something good, take care of our people, keep our clients satisfied, nurture our work ethic and reputation, build long-lasting partnerships, enjoy what we do and give back as much as possible.

**Job Description:**

The Deployment Project Manager supports healthcare technology management (HTM) work associated with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Federal Electronic Health Record Modernization (FEHRM) program. This role coordinates simultaneous deployment projects and workstreams across multiple VA medical centers. The Project Manager works directly with national, regional, and site-level Biomedical Engineering and clinical teams, technical teams, third-party vendors, and program management offices across the VA enterprise.

Successful candidates bring recent, practical experience with medical devices, facility HTM operations, or healthcare technology implementation, along with strong project coordination skills. They can follow a technical discussion, identify an unresolved issue, ask questions to understand its impact, and turn that information into a clear status update or escalation for leadership.

***\*Travel associated with this role will consist of being away for about a week every 2 months\****

**Responsibilities:**

* Ability to coordinate HTM deployment schedules, site dependencies, equipment and interface readiness, testing activities, and go-live preparation across multiple VA facilities.
* Track project milestones, risks, decisions, and action items; identify how unresolved issues may affect in-flight work or deployment readiness.
* Work with facility HTM, clinical teams, Oracle Health, vendors, and program stakeholders to clarify ownership, deliverables, and milestone status.
* Participate actively in technical and operational discussions. Ask focused follow-up questions when information is incomplete or conflicting, and track issues through resolution.
* Escalate concerns with a clear explanation of the issue, its potential impact, the decision needed, and the next steps.
* Prepare status reports, executive summaries, briefings, and meeting documentation that accurately capture decisions, owners, and follow-up actions.
* Support planning and coordination through readiness, testing, deployment, and post-deployment follow-up.
* Work within applicable VHA processes, federal requirements, and healthcare technology practices

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and at least 5 years relevant professional experience.
* Recent, practical experience in a hospital HTM department, medical device or imaging company, healthcare technology deployment, or a comparable field-based environment.
* Experience coordinating projects or complex work across technical, clinical, vendor, and leadership stakeholders.
* Working familiarity with medical devices and facility HTM activities sufficient to understand the work being tracked and recognize readiness concerns.
* Ability to identify the project implications of technical issues and communicate them clearly to technical teams and leadership.
* Strong organizational skills, sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting VHA operations or a multi-facility EHR deployment.
* Familiarity with Oracle Health Cerner Millennium or VA FEHRM.
* Experience coordinating medical device integration, equipment readiness, testing, or go-live activities.
* Familiarity with HTM equipment inventory or computerized maintenance management systems.
* Familiarity with applicable healthcare regulatory requirements and standards.
* Experience using tools, including AI-assisted tools, to improve documentation, analysis, or workflow efficiency.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a federal public trust clearance.

**Compensation:**

Salary for this position is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, location, the candidate's particular combination of knowledge, skills, competencies and experience, as well as contract specific affordability and organizational requirements. The proposed salary range for this position is outlined below.

**Salary range:** $95,000 - $125,000

XO Health is a technology-driven health plan built for self-insured employers. We serve employers, members, and providers through a value-based care network, a risk contracting engine, and a real-time data and analytics platform. The Implementation Lead owns the end-to-end onboarding of new employer groups and TPA partners, from signed agreement through effective date and a stable first 60 days. You are the single point of accountability for a clean, on-time go-live: the plan is built correctly, eligibility flows, ID cards and welcome kits land, the member app is configured, and the client knows exactly where things stand at every step.

* Translate client-specific requirements into clear instructions for internal teams and confirm they are executed correctly before go-live.

* Hand off cleanly to the ongoing account owner at the end of the stabilization period, with full documentation of the group's setup and any open items.

**Playbook and Continuous Improvement:**

* Own XO's implementation playbook: standard timelines, checklists, templates, and data requirements for employer and TPA onboarding.
* Identify manual steps and failure points in the process and work with Operations and Product to automate or remove them.
* Turn lessons from each implementation into playbook improvements that strengthen the process and enable scale ahead of growth.

**EXPERIENCE and EDUCATION:**

**Required:**

* 5+ years in implementation, client onboarding, or project management within self-funded health benefits, TPA operations, or a health plan.
* Working knowledge of self-funded medical and pharmacy plan design, and the compliance landscape that comes with it (ERISA, ACA, CAA, Mental Health Parity).

* Fluency in the employer and TPA distribution channel, including how brokers, consultants, benefits administrators, and stop-loss carriers fit together.

* Clear, concise communicator who can confidently lead client discussions and provide leadership with direct, well-informed answers.
* Strong organizational skills and the judgment to prioritize when everything feels urgent.

**Preferred**:

* Experience implementing on behalf of, or alongside, a TPA.
* Experience at an early-stage or high-growth company where you built the process rather than inherited it.
* Familiarity with health plan technology platforms, member apps, or provider directory tools.
* PMP or similar project management credentials.

***Accountability:*** you own the outcome and say so when something is off track.

***Critical Thinking:*** you solve problems from first principles and learn what the organization needs next.

***Change Champion:*** you are committed to building and comfortable when the plan changes.

***Relationships:***you build trust quickly with clients, partners, and colleagues.

jobs.title: Senior Channel Account Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

You will own partner-sourced revenue for eMaint across the Americas as the first dedicated hire on the eMaint Partner Network team. The role carries a quota, manages a portfolio of referral, reseller, technology, and delivery partners, and sets the standard for three more channel hires to follow in other regions.

About 75% of your time goes to growing the partners we already have, mainly through resale. The other 25% goes to using your own network to bring in new partners that fill gaps in industry, geography, or capability.

The program is young and growing fast. The foundation is in place: partner agreements, deal registration, a partner portal, enablement content, a rebate program, and a lead allocation process that routes target accounts to partners. Your job is to turn that foundation into predictable, repeatable partner revenue. Strategic alliance and distribution relationships that are still being built stay with the Indirect GTM Leader, so you can move quickly with partners who are already enabled and engaged.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who knows maintenance and reliability software, knows how partners make money, and wants to build something rather than inherit it.

What you will do

**Grow existing partners (about 75%)**

* Own a portfolio of Americas partners and the partner resell ARR (SaaS) and NRR (services or training) that come from it.
* Build a joint business plan with each priority partner: target accounts, pipeline goals, enablement milestones, and marketing commitments.
* Run quarterly business reviews that hold both sides accountable to the plan.
* Create pipeline with partners through account mapping, competitive displacement campaigns, and follow-up on leads eMaint allocates to them.
* Segment the portfolio by potential and performance, and put your time where it produces revenue.

**Co-sell and close**

* Work every partner deal as a co-sell with the eMaint Account Executive and solution team, with clear roles for the partner, the AE, and you.
* Manage deal registration, partner quoting, pricing, and order flow so deals move without friction.
* Coach partners on qualification, positioning against competing CMMS and EAM products, and deal strategy.
* Forecast partner bookings accurately in Salesforce every week.
* Resolve channel conflict early and fairly, using the program's rules of engagement.

**Build partner capability**

* Take new partners from signed agreement to first registered deal, then to first closed deal.
* Drive completion of sales and technical enablement so partners can position, demo, and scope eMaint on their own.
* Help reseller partners progress from subcontracting implementation to eMaint toward delivering implementation and first-line support themselves.
* Connect technology partners to joint solutions and referral opportunities that sales teams can sell.

**Recruit new partners (about 25%)**

* Use your network in the maintenance, reliability, and asset management community to source partners that match the eMaint ideal partner profile.
* Qualify partner prospects on commitment, capability, and market access before they enter onboarding.
* Prioritize recruitment where the Americas map has gaps in industry, country, or language coverage.

**Run the operating rhythm**

* Keep partner records, pipeline, and activity current in Salesforce and the partner portal.
* Track partner performance with visual management: pipeline, bookings, enablement status, and risks.
* Spend time in person with partners and their customers to see problems and opportunities firsthand.
* Bring partner feedback to Sales, Marketing, Product, Services, Sales Operations, and Legal, and help fix the process gaps it exposes.

jobs.title: Senior Business Resilience Program Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

#### **The Role**

Block’s Business Resilience is part of the Security Governance Risk and Compliance team. The Business Resilience helps ensure that critical products, services, operations, and supporting technology can continue through disruption and recover within expected timeframes. The team partners across business, technology, risk, compliance, legal, regional entities, and third-party teams to identify resilience risks, validate recovery capabilities, support governance expectations, and drive practical remediation.

This role will help operate and mature Block’s resilience program across business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, operational resilience, third-party resilience, testing, reporting, and regulatory compliance support. The role requires someone who can translate resilience requirements into clear business and technology actions, communicate risk in a practical way, and support accountable owners through testing, remediation, and governance.

The ideal candidate is also comfortable improving how resilience work gets done. They should be able to identify manual or repeatable workflows, support AI-enabled and automation opportunities, improve reporting and dashboards, help administer resilience tooling, and build scalable templates, evidence processes, and self-service mechanisms that reduce friction while improving quality, auditability, and regulatory confidence.

#### **You Will**

* Identify resilience risks across critical services, business functions, technology, and dependencies, including risks introduced by business, regulatory, or industry changes.
* Develop and maintain current, testable business continuity, disaster recovery, and crisis management plans aligned with recovery objectives, strategies, and resource needs.
* Coordinate resilience exercises and recovery tests, report findings, and partner with accountable owners to track remediation through completion.
* Assess third-party continuity and recovery capabilities, identify gaps, and support remediation.
* Communicate resilience posture, open risks, and decisions needed to governance forums, senior leaders, and Boards, and support audit, regulatory, customer, and RFP requests.
* Partner with regional entities, including the UK, EU, and Canada, to align global practices with local requirements and reduce duplication through shared controls, evidence, and reporting.
* Improve resilience workflows through AI, automation, dashboards, templates, and self-service tools, supporting requirements, testing, adoption, and troubleshooting with appropriate data, access, auditability, and human review controls.

#### **You Have**

* 6+ years of experience operating or improving global resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, or related risk programs, ideally in financial services or regulated technology.
* Strong knowledge of impact analysis, dependency mapping, recovery strategies, testing, remediation, and governance, with experience applying relevant standards or regulatory expectations (i.e. ISO22301, BS11200, FFIEC, EBA, FCI, CBI, or RPAA).
* Strong project management, organizational, and partnership skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and dependencies and drive cross-functional follow-through without direct authority.
* Excellent communication and analytical judgment, with the ability to translate complex risks and requirements into practical actions for technical, business, executive, and Board-level audiences.
* Comfort using AI, automation, data analysis, and reporting tools, with the ability to learn and administer new platforms, document processes, and translate stakeholder needs into workflow improvements.
* A relevant professional certification, such as those from DRI International or the Business Continuity Institute, or equivalent practical experience.

We’re working to build a more inclusive economy where our customers have equal access to opportunity, and we strive to live by these same values in building our workplace. Block is an equal opportunity employer evaluating all employees and job applicants without regard to identity or any legally protected class. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with state and local laws and “fair chance” ordinances.
  
  
We believe in being fair, and are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including providing reasonable accommodations to disabled applicants throughout the recruitment process. We encourage applicants to share any needed accommodations with their recruiter, who will treat these requests as confidentially as possible.

While there is no specific deadline to apply for this role, U.S. roles are typically open for an average of 55 days before being filled by a successful candidate. Please refer to the date listed at the top of this job page for when this role was first posted.

  

Block takes a market-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. U.S. locations are categorized into one of four zones based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. **About the Role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is looking for a Technical Account Manager to be the technical quarterback for our customers. You will own the full technical picture of each account: how Cyberhaven is architected and deployed, how it integrates with the customer's environment, how it is performing, and whether it is delivering the outcomes the customer bought it for. You will be the trusted technical advisor to Security, IT, and customer operations teams, and the connective tissue between those teams and Cyberhaven's Product, Engineering, and Customer Success organizations.

You will develop deep expertise in Cyberhaven's reimagined Agentic Data Security platform, including its inner workings, data lineage model, endpoint agents, and integrations. You will learn how our customers use it to mitigate data loss threats across their organizations. You are passionate about technology, naturally curious, and driven to exceed customer expectations. You take proactive ownership, anticipating issues before they surface, guiding customers toward best practices, and driving adoption and long-term value. When a problem needs engineering support, you own the escalation, bring a clear reproduction and technical context, and coordinate internally to full resolution.

Technical depth, a strong client focus, and experience with SaaS-based security products and endpoint agents (Windows, macOS, and Linux) are required. You will report to the Manager of Technical Account Managers.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Own the technical relationship**

  + Act as the technical owner of assigned accounts, with end-to-end knowledge of each customer's architecture, deployment, configuration, policies, and integrations.
  + Partner with customers and our Customer Experience teams through onboarding and rollout, including agent deployment strategy, policy design, and phased adoption plans.
  + Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across your book of business. Manage expectations and ensure stakeholder satisfaction.
  + Run regular check-ins and business reviews that cover technical health, adoption, risk, and goals. Raise emerging concerns before they escalate.

  ### **Be proactive**

  + Monitor account health, agent coverage, and usage patterns. Identify gaps, misconfigurations, and underused capabilities, and recommend optimizations.
  + Create and drive technical success plans that align customer objectives with Cyberhaven capabilities and deliverables.
  + Guide customers through upgrades, new feature rollouts, and environment changes (OS releases, MDM/GPO changes, network or infrastructure changes) to avoid disruption.
  + Advise customers on integrations with adjacent technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, and UEBA to extend the value of their deployment.
  + Stay current on industry trends and security best practices, and bring them to customers.

  ### **Resolve and escalate**

  + Analyze, troubleshoot, escalate and resolve complex technical issues across endpoint agents, cloud and SaaS integrations, and platform configuration.
  + Reproduce customer issues and document clear steps to replicate for Engineering and Development.
  + Serve as the internal and external point of contact on critical escalations. Drive prioritization with support engineering and keep customers informed through resolution.
  + Perform root cause analysis and drive preventive follow-ups so issues do not repeat.

  ### **Be the voice of the customer**

  + Coordinate customer feedback and feature requests to Product Management, Development, and Operations, with the technical and business context behind them.
  + Work cross-functionally as the expert on the Customer.
  + Collaborate with Customer Success and Sales on renewals, expansions, and risk mitigation, providing technical input and account insight.
  + Develop and maintain knowledge base articles, playbooks, and best-practice resources.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 3+ years of hands-on EDR/DLP endpoint experience.
* Expertise with DLP, Insider Threat, and CASB solutions.
* 3+ years in a Technical Account Management, Solutions/Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Technical Support, or similar customer-facing technical role.
* Demonstrated ability to own customer technical outcomes from implementation through steady-state operation, and to understand a customer's architecture and environment end-to-end.
* Hands-on experience deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting SaaS-based security and/or endpoint agent technologies.
* Proven experience resolving escalated technical customer issues and working directly with engineering teams.
* Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities, set timelines, track progress, and maintain clear documentation (success plans, project plans, status reports).
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English), including the ability to engage both hands-on practitioners and executive stakeholders.
* Practical knowledge of networking, security products, and enterprise network infrastructure.
* Deep knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Linux, including SCCM, GPO, Intune, registry configuration, PowerShell scripting, MDM, application management, and basic terminal skills.
* Software debugging skills: reading and searching logs (Windows, macOS, Linux, and Google Kubernetes Engine), running diagnostic scripts, and process management.
* Knowledge of system software design (services, drivers, agents).
* Based in EST timezone to support our customers.

### **Desired**

* Familiarity with adjacent technologies that Cyberhaven integrates with (SIEM, SOAR, UEBA).
* Prior experience as a TAM or in a similar proactive, account-owning role at a security or SaaS company.
* Background in L2/L3 or Escalation Engineering for EDR or DLP tools. This is a plus, not a primary requirement.

**VOALA**

***Helping Our Most Vulnerable Change Their Life Stories***

Volunteers of America is a non-profit human services organization committed to serving people in need, strengthening families, and building communities. VOALA provides a variety of social services to Los Angeles area communities such as Head Start programs, Upward Bound college prep programs, veterans’ services, homeless shelters, low-income housing program as well as drug and alcohol rehabilitation. Learn more at www.voala.org.

**PAY RATE:** $24.99 - $26.30 Per Hour

**BENEFITS:** VOALA offers competitive medical, dental, vision and retirement benefits.

**JOB SUMMARY AND PURPOSE**

The Care Manager (Generalist) provides intensive care to program participants who have been, or are currently, involved with criminal justice system as well as suffering from co-occurring disorders, meeting participants at least weekly. The Care Manager is the primary point of contact to coordinate services and care for assigned clients. This position provides clients with the highest levels of acuity and co-morbidities individualized care through access to service linkages, counseling, treatment planning, and various crisis intervention methods in order to prepare individuals for further success

* Facilitates support groups, and group education events.
* Appears in court or other government agencies as advocate for clients relating to re-entry into society

As service providers to the underprivileged and vulnerable in our community, all employees are considered Mandated Reporters, and must report any instance of physical or sexual abuse to proper authorities.

Qualifications

* Must be able to pass a fingerprint clearance, background check, including criminal history, personal references, employment and education verifications

**PENTAX Medica**l is a global medical device company focused on **flexible endoscopy** **systems**. jobs.title: Senior Consultant, Process Improvement
jobs.description:
**Senior Consultant, Process Improvement**

Management Systems: Quality, Food Safety, Safety, Environmental

Independent contractor | $100 to $110 per hour | Southeast or Mid-Atlantic US | About 50% travel

**About the role**

Spinnaker International is hiring a **Senior Consultant** to work as the second member of a two-person core team on a **multiyear process improvement program** at a large food and beverage manufacturer. You will work directly with the **Engagement Lead** every day. You will build the **baseline** , the **cost models** , and the **analysis** that drive the design. You will turn large volumes of plant data, interviews, and documents into **clear presentations** that executives act on.

This is a **process improvement** role first. The subject matter is an enterprise **management system** covering quality, food safety, safety, and environmental programs certified to **ISO** and **FSSC 22000** standards. We need someone who has done this work inside industry, has implemented these standards before, and now applies that experience as a **consultant** .

The role spans all four phases of the program, from the first plant visit to the final confirmation of results. You **take direction from the Engagement Lead** and work with the Engagement Lead every day, so that what you are working on at any given time **aligns with the overall direction of the program** . As the program scales to more plants, this role may **coordinate additional Spinnaker resources** under that same direction.

**The engagement**

The client operates **multiple manufacturing plants** across several states. Its management system has grown more complex than the business it serves. The program will **simplify** the system into one risk-based framework, **redesign** the governance and review processes around it, **rationalize** the supporting technology, and **align** every plant to a common operating model.

The program follows the Spinnaker method: **Measure, Design, Implement, Confirm.** The first phase establishes a quantified baseline through plant visits and analysis. Design follows. Implementation runs plant by plant with structured change management.

**What you** **will do**

**Measure.** Establish the baseline the whole program is built on.

* Build the **enterprise baseline** : controlled documents, audit programs, management review, governance, and the platforms that support them.

* Lead **plant-level assessments** on site. Observe **practice against procedure** on the floor, in the lab, and in the control room. Interview operators, supervisors, quality and safety managers, and plant leadership.

* Build the **cost of compliance model** in Excel, analyze **audit finding patterns** , score each plant on a **maturity profile** , and identify **quick wins** for the first executive readout.

**Design.** Shape the future-state system and the plan to reach it.

* Design **one tiered document hierarchy** and write the policies and procedures that anchor it, in language plant teams will follow.

* Redesign the **internal audit program** and **management review** so both are risk-weighted, exception-based, and fed from existing systems.

* Define **platform requirements** , support the consolidation decision, and build the **training and competency framework** .

**Implement and Confirm.** Make it real at every plant, then prove it held.

* Run the **pilot plant** and then the **multi-plant rollout** : training, onboarding, change management, and the controlled retirement of duplicate documents and platforms.

* Track **results against the baseline** , hand the system to its client owners, and confirm the gain holds.

* Throughout, draft **executive presentations** and working papers with the Engagement Lead. Use **AI tools** daily to analyze, draft, and build. Verify everything they produce.

**Required**

* **Hands-on process improvement** experience. You have led Lean or Six Sigma projects that changed how a plant or a corporate function works, and you can show the before and after in numbers. A **Lean or Six Sigma certification** is required. The belt level matters less to us than the results.

* **Seven or more years** in food or beverage manufacturing, in quality, food safety, operations, or continuous improvement roles. Industry experience is required. Consulting experience on top of it is a strong plus.

* You have **implemented or led** an ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, or FSSC 22000 management system through at least one full certification cycle.

* You have **deployed a management system or a process change across more than one site** , and you know what it takes to get plant teams to adopt it.

* You **synthesize** . You can take hundreds of documents, dozens of interviews, and a messy data set, build the **Excel model** behind it, and produce a **clear, defensible executive presentation** .

* You **already use current AI models** such as Claude or ChatGPT in your work and are willing to make them a daily tool. You check their output before anyone else sees it.

* You are willing to **travel about half of your working weeks** for two-to-three-day plant visits.

**Preferred**

* **Beverage bottling** experience: batching, clean-in-place, line changeover, labeling controls, statistical process control.

* Experience harmonizing procedures and documents after an **acquisition or integration** .

* Experience with **internal audit program design** or **management review** redesign.

* **Training design and delivery** , including onboarding for plant quality and safety roles.

* Experience defining **platform requirements** or selecting quality, document, or EHS systems.

* Working knowledge of the **2026 editions** of ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 and of **FSSC 22000 Version 7** .

* **Lead auditor** training (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001, or FSSC 22000) or **PCQI** .

At groundcover, we build fast, and our office is where the energy happens. As part of our growing Operations team, you will be central to making our San Francisco office run seamlessly while driving team culture and company momentum.

This role is an exceptional opportunity for someone looking to bridge the worlds of workplace employee experience and hands-on marketing events. Working closely with our VP Marketing, you’ll get to blend day-to-day office ownership with the excitement of producing high-impact marketing events and conferences.

**Important: this is a full-time, in-office role based in our office in San Francisco. We’re looking for someone who wants to be present, and sees in-office ownership as an advantage!**

**What You'll Own**

* **The office, end to end:** Run all daily operations across facilities, supplies and vendor relationships. Be the first to notice what’s not working and the first to fix it.
* **Manage and track office budgets:** Manage vendor contracts for everything from catering and equipment to event logistics.
* **Culture and employee experience:** Own our SF office culture moments, team celebrations, Happy Hours, company swag and the day-to-day initiatives that make this a

place people are glad to come to.

* **Onboarding & operations support:** Coordinate with People team and IT to make new-hire arrivals seamless and departures smooth as part of the core Operations team.
* **Marketing events:** Work closely with the Marketing team to support select events, meetups, and industry conferences, providing hands-on exposure to event marketing.

Help coordinate logistics, vendors, promotional materials and swag, and support event execution and on-site activities. Take ownership of select event-related projects and

tasks as needed.

  
Requirements:
  

* 1-2 years of experience in office management, workplace operations, or a similar role -ideally at a fast-growing startup or tech company.
* Multitasking & adaptability: Detail-oriented, and ability to juggle multiple moving parts, prioritize effectively, and stay calm and clear-headed when plans change quickly.
* High motivation: passion, and ambition to step into and build a career at the intersection of Office Operations, Employee Experience, and Marketing Events.
* High ownership mentality: A self-starter who doesn't wait to be told what needs doing; you thrive when given ownership and autonomy.

new_jobs.title: BEVERAGE CATERING SALES & OPERATIONS MANAGER
new_jobs.description:
**Beverage Catering Sales & Operations Manager**

**Columbus Cafe | San Francisco, CA**  
**Part-time | 25–35 hours per week**  
**$20–$25/hour base + performance-based commission**

Columbus Cafe is launching an off-site beverage catering business, and we’re looking for an experienced hospitality professional to help build and grow it.

This is not primarily a bartending job. We’re looking for someone who can **sell events, build client relationships, organize operations, and manage events from the first inquiry through completion.**

We already have the Columbus Cafe brand, initial beverage concepts, operating resources, and the licensing foundation. We need someone who can take ownership of the catering business and help turn it into a profitable, repeatable operation.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Develop new business through outreach, referrals, planners, venues, weddings, corporate events, private parties, and hospitality relationships.
* Respond to inquiries, meet with clients, prepare proposals, follow up, and close business.
* Help refine beverage packages, pricing, minimums, and upgrades.
* Manage confirmed events from planning through execution.
* Coordinate staffing, beverage quantities, purchasing, transportation, setup, and event logistics.
* Track leads, bookings, event costs, and profitability.
* Build repeat and referral business after successful events.

**Who We’re Looking For:**

We’re especially interested in candidates with experience in:

* Catering or event sales
* Hotel or restaurant events
* Beverage catering or mobile bars
* Weddings or corporate events
* Hospitality business development
* Event production

The strongest candidate will be a confident salesperson, highly organized, comfortable working independently, and able to manage multiple clients and events at the same time.

Existing relationships with Bay Area event planners, venues, hotels, corporate clients, or wedding professionals are especially valuable.

Experience with California alcohol compliance or off-site beverage service is helpful, but not required.

**Compensation:**

This is an **employee position paying $20–$25 per hour, plus substantial performance-based commission** tied to the business you help generate and the profitability of completed events.

Approved business expenses will be reimbursed.

Specific commission terms will be discussed during the interview process and documented in writing before employment begins.

**Schedule:**

Approximately **25–35 hours per week during the launch period**, depending on sales activity and event volume.

The schedule is flexible, but some evening and weekend availability is required for events.

Why This Role Is Different

This is an opportunity to help build a new business rather than simply step into an existing management position.

Columbus Cafe will provide the brand, resources, initial concepts, and overall direction. The person in this role will have meaningful influence over how the catering operation develops and will participate financially in the business they help create.

If you have experience selling and managing events and want more independence and upside than a conventional hospitality position, we’d like to hear from you.

Please submit your résumé and a short note describing your relevant catering, hospitality, event-sales, or business-development experience.

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 25.0 – 35.0 per week

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* catering, event sales, or hospitality/event production: 3 years (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* San Francisco, CA (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA (San Francisco County)
