new_jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high-risk product decisions, often in fast-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively identifying important problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to the strategy and roadmap for cross-functional risk review. This role requires sound judgment, strategic thinking, and experience operating across multiple risk domains.This is a senior individual-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering large-scale programs, aligning solutions across multiple teams, and gaining recognition as a subject-matter expert whose advice is sought out across the product and risk community.  
  
  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the triage and escalation process for product risks that are novel, ambiguous, or policy-challenging
* Coordinate across Legal, Policy, Data Strategy, Engineering, and Product to ensure high-risk reviews are surfaced and addressed with the appropriate depth and speed
* network with and appropriately involve key stakeholders, persuading diverse audiences to drive progress
* Translate complex technical and product concepts into structured assessments and recommendations
* Facilitate decision-making through risk-based frameworks that support both product velocity and compliance
* seek clarity on goals and priorities so work can move forward quickly, and escalate as needed
* Ensure escalations are documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency, maintaining appropriate documentation and timely follow-through
* Identify gaps or breakdowns in current escalation/review processes and drive improvements in workflows, guidance, or tooling
* actively experiment and seek opportunities to simplify work through AI-integrated workflows
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations and make decisions that reflect our mission, values, and principles, informed by risk reviews and compliance guidance

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust & safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver time-sensitive, high-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists
* Strong communication and cross-functional alignment skills — especially in navigating sensitive tradeoffs
* Familiarity with data flows, technical systems, and/or understanding of product risks and their applicable mitigations
* Track record of influencing decisions and driving progress without formal authority
* Experience building, improving, or operationalizing risk review, escalation, assessment, or governance processes
* Strong judgment in situations involving competing priorities, incomplete information, and significant business, regulatory, safety, privacy, or reputational risk
* Experience using AI/automation to improve complex workflows, analysis, decision-making, or operational processes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort embracing ambiguity and improving systems

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing and driving strategy or roadmap for cross-functional projects and/or teams
Experience with product launches, 0* 1 products, emerging technologies, or novel product capabilities
* Background in triaging or adjudicating product-level risks, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience working with AI agents, automation, or other emerging technologies to improve risk assessment and operational efficiency
* Comfort presenting risk perspectives to senior stakeholders and leading through ambiguity
* Understanding of regulatory, reputational, or policy risks related to consumer-facing technology
* Experience with consumer-facing technology, platforms, AI/ML products, infrastructure, or other technically complex products
* Experience working on privacy, content, legal, or compliance-related product issues
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

**About us:**

For over three decades, Cirtec Medical has been a leading outsourcing partner for complex medical devices. We specialize in providing comprehensive solutions for Class II and III devices, from design and development to precision components and finished device assembly. Our expertise spans neuromodulation, implantable drug delivery, cardiac rhythm management, structural heart, mechanical circulatory support, and minimally invasive surgical systems.

Our dedicated teams prioritize growth, innovation, and collaboration. We actively seek opportunities for improvement to enhance our support for clients. If you embrace a growth mindset and thrive on challenges, you may be a perfect fit for our team!

**Position Summary:**

The Quality Manager will be responsible for the leadership and management of Quality personnel and resources to ensure compliance to Cirtec Medical’s Quality Management System. The Quality Manager will also be responsible for overseeing Quality engineering activities to support sustaining manufacturing operations, and product development programs.

new_jobs.title: Knowledge Archiving and Support Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
### **Company Description**

**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

### **Job Description**

We have an opening for a **Knowledge Archiving and Support (KAS) Program Manager** to work within the Knowledge Management program. You will be responsible for overseeing Strategic Deterrence (SD) digitization operations, knowledge preservation and curation, and access to legacy technical materials through the Research & Knowledge Services and Digitization Services teams. You will manage assigned knowledge-service operations, implement established strategies, standards, and governance practices, resolve complex operational issues, and provide recommendations regarding service priorities, resources, and process improvements.You will coordinate closely with the Taxonomy Program and Knowledge Applications team on metadata standards, semantic governance, and repository integration, though semantic model development itself sits outside this role’s scope. This position will be in the Administration Division within the Operations and Business Directorate and is matrixed to the Strategic Deterrence Directorate.

*This position may offer a hybrid schedule, which includes the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week, after a probationary period. The specifics of the hybrid schedule, including the exact number of days required in the office and virtual work options, may vary based on the needs of the team and the organization.*

This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

**You will**

* Oversee day-to-day operations of the Research & Knowledge Services and Digitization Services teams, including direct supervision of assigned staff and coordination of work with the Research & Knowledge Services Team Lead and Digitization Services Team Lead.
* Contribute to and implement service-area strategic plans for SD digitization, archiving, and knowledge-structuring activities; coordinate with the Taxonomy Program Manager to ensure appropriate application of metadata standards to digitized and repository content.
* Establish and oversee adoption of a prioritization framework for digitization activities and SD digitization standards, including sustaining a formal digitization governance framework (e.g., Federal Agencies Digital Guidelines Initiative (FADGI) compliance, permanent-records digitization pilots) as an ongoing operational practice.
* Manage escalated Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) operational issues and support sustainable workflow practices in partnership with the FOIA Coordinator on process and workload management.
* Represent KAS in program-level planning and stakeholder engagement alongside the Taxonomy Program Manager and Knowledge Applications Product Manager.
* Maintain effective relationships with SD stakeholders, program partners, records and information-management organizations, and service providers.
* Foster staff development through coaching, knowledge sharing, training, and feedback while maintaining accountability for service quality and delivery.

**Additional job responsibilities, at the A07.4 level**

* Resolve cross-functional operational gaps affecting digitization and reference services (e.g., intake processes, coverage of physically distributed digitization spaces, coordination with partner organizations handling related materials).
* Serve as PI/budget owner for KAS staffing actions within Research & Knowledge Services and Digitization Services.

The Customer Experience Analyst manages the day-to-day execution and analysis of Robert Half’s customer experience listening programs across client and candidate journeys. Responsibilities include administering surveys and feedback channels, analyzing quantitative and qualitative data, developing reports and visualizations, and monitoring customer signals across multiple sources. Working with internal teams and external partners, the analyst helps test and improve listening programs and expand the use of automation, text analytics, and AI-assisted analysis. The analyst independently investigates customer experience trends, identifies emerging risks, and recommends improvements to listening programs and reporting processes.

**What You'll Do**

Customer Experience Analysis, Reporting, and Data Quality

* Own recurring customer experience reporting cycles, including data preparation, quality assurance, and development of summaries and materials for CX leadership to present.
* Independently analyze survey results, trends, and segments using appropriate statistical methods.
* Analyze open-text feedback using established coding frameworks, taxonomies, and validation rules.
* Create PowerPoint charts, tables and summaries that explain meaningful patterns, changes, and areas requiring deeper investigation.
* Use text analytics and artificial intelligence tools for theme identification and summarization, validating outputs against source data and established coding standards.
* Support report automation, dashboard maintenance, data-feed validation, and improvements to repeatable analysis and reporting processes.

Customer Experience Listening Program Execution

* Independently manage established customer experience survey programs, including programming, distributions, contact lists, suppression rules, workflows, and ongoing maintenance.

* Conduct customer experience analysis and investigations to answer business questions and support decision-making.
* Monitor dashboards and structured and unstructured data sources for notable changes, emerging themes, and customer friction.
* Review reporting alerts and threshold changes, validate the signal, document findings, and share results with the appropriate team.
* Partner with Customer Experience, Design, Digital, Technology, Data, and other teams to support research and measurement initiatives.

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, research, analytics, social sciences, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Previous work/professional experience (Type and # of years): 5+ years in customer experience, customer insights, survey research, market research, analytics, or related work.

As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high-risk product decisions, often in fast-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively identifying important problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to the strategy and roadmap for cross-functional risk review. This role requires sound judgment, strategic thinking, and experience operating across multiple risk domains.This is a senior individual-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering large-scale programs, aligning solutions across multiple teams, and gaining recognition as a subject-matter expert whose advice is sought out across the product and risk community.

* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver time-sensitive, high-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists

Experience with product launches, 0* 1 products, emerging technologies, or novel product capabilities

new_jobs.title: Senior Channel Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
About the role

You will own partner-sourced revenue for eMaint across the Americas as the first dedicated hire on the eMaint Partner Network team. The role carries a quota, manages a portfolio of referral, reseller, technology, and delivery partners, and sets the standard for three more channel hires to follow in other regions.

About 75% of your time goes to growing the partners we already have, mainly through resale. The other 25% goes to using your own network to bring in new partners that fill gaps in industry, geography, or capability.

The program is young and growing fast. The foundation is in place: partner agreements, deal registration, a partner portal, enablement content, a rebate program, and a lead allocation process that routes target accounts to partners. Your job is to turn that foundation into predictable, repeatable partner revenue. Strategic alliance and distribution relationships that are still being built stay with the Indirect GTM Leader, so you can move quickly with partners who are already enabled and engaged.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who knows maintenance and reliability software, knows how partners make money, and wants to build something rather than inherit it.

What you will do

**Grow existing partners (about 75%)**

* Own a portfolio of Americas partners and the partner resell ARR (SaaS) and NRR (services or training) that come from it.
* Build a joint business plan with each priority partner: target accounts, pipeline goals, enablement milestones, and marketing commitments.
* Run quarterly business reviews that hold both sides accountable to the plan.
* Create pipeline with partners through account mapping, competitive displacement campaigns, and follow-up on leads eMaint allocates to them.
* Segment the portfolio by potential and performance, and put your time where it produces revenue.

**Co-sell and close**

* Work every partner deal as a co-sell with the eMaint Account Executive and solution team, with clear roles for the partner, the AE, and you.
* Manage deal registration, partner quoting, pricing, and order flow so deals move without friction.
* Coach partners on qualification, positioning against competing CMMS and EAM products, and deal strategy.
* Forecast partner bookings accurately in Salesforce every week.
* Resolve channel conflict early and fairly, using the program's rules of engagement.

**Build partner capability**

* Take new partners from signed agreement to first registered deal, then to first closed deal.
* Drive completion of sales and technical enablement so partners can position, demo, and scope eMaint on their own.
* Help reseller partners progress from subcontracting implementation to eMaint toward delivering implementation and first-line support themselves.
* Connect technology partners to joint solutions and referral opportunities that sales teams can sell.

**Recruit new partners (about 25%)**

* Use your network in the maintenance, reliability, and asset management community to source partners that match the eMaint ideal partner profile.
* Qualify partner prospects on commitment, capability, and market access before they enter onboarding.
* Prioritize recruitment where the Americas map has gaps in industry, country, or language coverage.

**Run the operating rhythm**

* Keep partner records, pipeline, and activity current in Salesforce and the partner portal.
* Track partner performance with visual management: pipeline, bookings, enablement status, and risks.
* Spend time in person with partners and their customers to see problems and opportunities firsthand.
* Bring partner feedback to Sales, Marketing, Product, Services, Sales Operations, and Legal, and help fix the process gaps it exposes.
* Document what works as standard work so the next channel hires can adopt it.

**What success looks like:**

* **First 30 days:** You have met every active Americas partner, completed eMaint product and partner enablement, and reviewed the open partner pipeline deal by deal.
* **First 90 days:** The portfolio is segmented, the top partners have signed joint business plans, the first QBR cycle is complete, and your forecast is trusted.
* **First 6 months:** Partner-sourced pipeline is growing quarter over quarter, more partners have closed their first deal, and at least two new partners recruited from your network are in onboarding.
* **First 12 months:** You have met or exceeded your partner resell ARR and NRR targets, and the playbook you built is the template for the next regional channel hires.

**What you bring:**

* 8 or more years in asset management, spanning CMMS, EAM, or maintenance and reliability.
* 5 or more years in channel or alliance management with ownership of a partner revenue number. Channel experience is preferred.
* A record of meeting or exceeding quota through resellers, referral partners, or systems integrators.
* Hands-on Salesforce experience managing opportunities, accounts, forecasts, deal registration, and reports.
* Experience running co-sell motions with direct Account Executives and resolving channel conflict.
* Skill in joint business planning and QBRs with partner owners and executives.
* Commercial judgment on pricing, discounting, partner margin, and incentive programs.
* Clear written and spoken communication, and the presence to hold a partner executive accountable.
* Ability to work independently in a remote role and to travel up to 35%.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* Residence and work authorization in the United States.

**Nice to have:**

* Spanish language proficiency.
* Experience managing partners in Latin America or the Caribbean.
* Experience on an early-stage channel team where the program was still being built.
* Experience developing partners into implementation and support providers, not only resellers.

new_jobs.title: Senior Consultant, Process Improvement
new_jobs.description:
**Senior Consultant, Process Improvement**

Management Systems: Quality, Food Safety, Safety, Environmental

Independent contractor | $100 to $110 per hour | Southeast or Mid-Atlantic US | About 50% travel

**About the role**

Spinnaker International is hiring a **Senior Consultant** to work as the second member of a two-person core team on a **multiyear process improvement program** at a large food and beverage manufacturer. You will work directly with the **Engagement Lead** every day. You will build the **baseline** , the **cost models** , and the **analysis** that drive the design. You will turn large volumes of plant data, interviews, and documents into **clear presentations** that executives act on.

This is a **process improvement** role first. The subject matter is an enterprise **management system** covering quality, food safety, safety, and environmental programs certified to **ISO** and **FSSC 22000** standards. We need someone who has done this work inside industry, has implemented these standards before, and now applies that experience as a **consultant** .

The role spans all four phases of the program, from the first plant visit to the final confirmation of results. You **take direction from the Engagement Lead** and work with the Engagement Lead every day, so that what you are working on at any given time **aligns with the overall direction of the program** . As the program scales to more plants, this role may **coordinate additional Spinnaker resources** under that same direction.

**The engagement**

The client operates **multiple manufacturing plants** across several states. Its management system has grown more complex than the business it serves. The program will **simplify** the system into one risk-based framework, **redesign** the governance and review processes around it, **rationalize** the supporting technology, and **align** every plant to a common operating model.

The program follows the Spinnaker method: **Measure, Design, Implement, Confirm.** The first phase establishes a quantified baseline through plant visits and analysis. Design follows. Implementation runs plant by plant with structured change management.

**What you** **will do**

**Measure.** Establish the baseline the whole program is built on.

* Build the **enterprise baseline** : controlled documents, audit programs, management review, governance, and the platforms that support them.

* Lead **plant-level assessments** on site. Observe **practice against procedure** on the floor, in the lab, and in the control room. Interview operators, supervisors, quality and safety managers, and plant leadership.

* Build the **cost of compliance model** in Excel, analyze **audit finding patterns** , score each plant on a **maturity profile** , and identify **quick wins** for the first executive readout.

**Design.** Shape the future-state system and the plan to reach it.

* Design **one tiered document hierarchy** and write the policies and procedures that anchor it, in language plant teams will follow.

* Redesign the **internal audit program** and **management review** so both are risk-weighted, exception-based, and fed from existing systems.

* Define **platform requirements** , support the consolidation decision, and build the **training and competency framework** .

**Implement and Confirm.** Make it real at every plant, then prove it held.

* Run the **pilot plant** and then the **multi-plant rollout** : training, onboarding, change management, and the controlled retirement of duplicate documents and platforms.

* Track **results against the baseline** , hand the system to its client owners, and confirm the gain holds.

* Throughout, draft **executive presentations** and working papers with the Engagement Lead. Use **AI tools** daily to analyze, draft, and build. Verify everything they produce.

**Required**

* **Hands-on process improvement** experience. You have led Lean or Six Sigma projects that changed how a plant or a corporate function works, and you can show the before and after in numbers. A **Lean or Six Sigma certification** is required. The belt level matters less to us than the results.

* **Seven or more years** in food or beverage manufacturing, in quality, food safety, operations, or continuous improvement roles. Industry experience is required. Consulting experience on top of it is a strong plus.

* You have **implemented or led** an ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, or FSSC 22000 management system through at least one full certification cycle.

* You have **deployed a management system or a process change across more than one site** , and you know what it takes to get plant teams to adopt it.

* You **synthesize** . You can take hundreds of documents, dozens of interviews, and a messy data set, build the **Excel model** behind it, and produce a **clear, defensible executive presentation** .

* You **already use current AI models** such as Claude or ChatGPT in your work and are willing to make them a daily tool. You check their output before anyone else sees it.

* You are willing to **travel about half of your working weeks** for two-to-three-day plant visits.

**Preferred**

* **Beverage bottling** experience: batching, clean-in-place, line changeover, labeling controls, statistical process control.

* Experience harmonizing procedures and documents after an **acquisition or integration** .

* Experience with **internal audit program design** or **management review** redesign.

* **Training design and delivery** , including onboarding for plant quality and safety roles.

* Experience defining **platform requirements** or selecting quality, document, or EHS systems.

* Working knowledge of the **2026 editions** of ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 and of **FSSC 22000 Version 7** .

* **Lead auditor** training (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001, or FSSC 22000) or **PCQI** .
